2771-the-island-pharisees.title: The Island Pharisees
2771-the-island-pharisees.creator: John Galsworthy
2771-the-island-pharisees.description: A book by John Galsworthy. And when he comes to the next inn, and snuggles in his well-warmed, bed, he thinks of the wild waste of heather where he might have had to spend the night alone beneath the stars; nor does it, I think, occur to him that the broad road he treads all day was once a trackless heath itself.

42328-an-unofficial-patriot.title: An Unofficial Patriot
42328-an-unofficial-patriot.creator: Helen Gardener
42328-an-unofficial-patriot.description: A book by Helen Gardener. It was in the year eighteen hundred and twenty-four that the great sea of Methodism first began to beat with a force that was like that of a succession of mighty tidal waves upon the previously placid State of Virginia.

arxiv-2109-01481.title: Alternating Minimization for Computed Tomography with Unknown Geometry Parameters.
arxiv-2109-01481.creator: Phuong Mai Huynh Pham
arxiv-2109-01481.description: Abstract Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, there is an increasing demand for portable CT machines worldwide in order to diagnose patients in a variety of settings. This has led to a need for CT image reconstruction algorithms that can produce high quality images in the case when multiple types of geometry parameters have been perturbed.

arxiv-2206-10191.title: Simulation of the 4H-SiC Low Gain Avalanche Diode Journal: NIM A
arxiv-2206-10191.creator: Tao Yang, Yuhang Tan, Congcong Wang, Xiyuan Zhang, Xin Shi
arxiv-2206-10191.description: Abstract Silicon Carbide device (4H-SiC) has potential radiation hardness, high saturated carrier velocity and low temperature sensitivity theoretically. The Silicon Low Gain Avalanche Diode (LGAD) has been verified to have excellent time performance. Therefore, the 4H-SiC LGAD is introduced in this work for application to detect the Minimum Ionization Particles (MIPs).

arxiv-2404-01953.title: Classifying Graphemes in English Words Through the Application of a Fuzzy Inference System
arxiv-2404-01953.creator: Samuel Rose, Chandrasekhar Kambhampati
arxiv-2404-01953.description: Abstract In Linguistics, a grapheme is a written unit of a writing system corresponding to a phonological sound. In Natural Language Processing tasks, written language is analysed through two different mediums, word analysis, and character analysis. This paper focuses on a third approach, the analysis of graphemes.

arxiv-2404-15224.title: Deep Models for Multi-View 3D Object Recognition: A Review
arxiv-2404-15224.creator: Mona Alzahrani, Muhammad Usman, Salma Kammoun, Saeed Anwar, Tarek Helmy
arxiv-2404-15224.description: Abstract Human decision-making often relies on visual information from multiple perspectives or views. In contrast, machine learning-based object recognition utilizes information from a single image of the object. However, the information conveyed by a single image may not be sufficient for accurate decision-making, particularly in complex recognition problems.

arxiv-2405-17159.title: Stop! In the Name of Flaws : Disentangling Personal Names and Sociodemographic Attributes in NLP
arxiv-2405-17159.creator: Vagrant Gautam, Arjun Subramonian, Anne Lauscher, Os Keyes
arxiv-2405-17159.description: Abstract Personal names simultaneously differentiate individuals and categorize them in ways that are important in a given society. While the natural language processing community has thus associated personal names with sociodemographic characteristics in a variety of tasks, researchers have engaged to varying degrees with the established methodological problems in doing so.

arxiv-2501-06497.title: PASS: Presentation Automation for Slide Generation and Speech
arxiv-2501-06497.creator: Tushar Aggarwal, Aarohi Bhand
arxiv-2501-06497.description: Abstract In today’s fast-paced world, effective presentations have become an essential tool for communication in both online and offline meetings. The crafting of a compelling presentation requires significant time and effort, from gathering key insights to designing slides that convey information clearly and concisely.

arxiv-2502-11454.title: UniCBE: An Uniformity-driven Comparing Based Evaluation Framework with Unified Multi-Objective Optimization
arxiv-2502-11454.creator: Peiwen Yuan, Shaoxiong Feng, Yiwei Li, Xinglin Wang, Yueqi Zhang, Jiayi Shi, Chuyi Tan, Boyuan Pan, Yao Hu, Kan Li
arxiv-2502-11454.description: Abstract Human preference plays a significant role in measuring large language models and guiding them to align with human values. Unfortunately, current comparing-based evaluation (CBE) methods typically focus on a single optimization objective, failing to effectively utilize scarce yet valuable preference signals.

arxiv-2503-07438.title: Sum-of-Squares Data-driven Robustly Stabilizing and Contracting Controller Synthesis for Polynomial Nonlinear Systems
arxiv-2503-07438.creator: Hamza El-Kebir, Melkior Ornik
arxiv-2503-07438.description: Abstract This work presents a computationally efficient approach to data-driven robust contracting controller synthesis for polynomial control-affine systems based on a sum-of-squares program. In particular, we consider the case in which a system alternates between periods of high-quality sensor data and low-quality sensor data.

arxiv-2602-06567.title: Markov Decision Processes of the Third Kind: Learning Distributions by Policy Gradient Descent ∗ Corresponding author
arxiv-2602-06567.creator: Nicole Bäuerle, Athanasios Vasileiadis ∗
arxiv-2602-06567.description: Abstract . The goal of this paper is to analyze distributional Markov Decision Processes as a class of control problems in which the objective is to learn policies that steer the distribution of a cumulative reward toward a prescribed target law, rather than optimizing an expected value or a risk functional.

pmc-10638667.title: Impact of DaxibotulinumtoxinA for Injection on Brow Position and Frontalis Muscle Activity Following Treatment of Glabellar Lines
pmc-10638667.creator: Nowell Solish, Michael A C Kane, Brian S Biesman, Jessica Brown, Conor J Gallagher
pmc-10638667.description: BackgroundBotulinum toxin type A (BoNTA) injections for the treatment of facial lines may lead to pleasant or undesirable changes in eyebrow height and position.ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to evaluate the impact of glabellar injection of DaxibotulinumtoxinA for Injection (DAXI), a novel BoNTA formulation, on eyebrow position and frontalis activity.

pmc-11317983.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations of the Eye Lens Water Channel Aquaporin 0 from Fish
pmc-11317983.creator: J Alfredo Freites, Douglas J Tobias
pmc-11317983.description: Aquaporin 0 (AQP0) plays a key role in water circulation in the eye lens through a variety of functions. In contrast to mammalian genomes, zebrafish contains two aqp0 genes leading to a separation of AQP0 multiple functions between the two gene products, Aqp0a and Aqp0b.

pmc-11375235.title: Assessment of potentially toxic element contents in chickens and poultry feeds from Bangladesh markets: Implications for human health risk
pmc-11375235.creator: Shamim Al Mamun, Mohammad A Islam, Shamshad B Quraishi, Mohammad M Hosen, Brett H Robinson, Ismail MM Rahman
pmc-11375235.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Chicken (Gallus domesticus) is a significant source of animal protein for the people of Bangladesh. However, anthropogenic activity may contaminate chicken meat with potentially toxic elements (PTEs) despite the nutritional benefits. Current work aims to determine the accumulated content of PTEs (Pb, Cd, Cr, As, and Hg) in chickens and poultry feeds commercially sold in Bangladesh markets and compare with WHO, FAO, EU, EC, FSANZ standards.

pmc-11378113.title: Ipilimumab and nivolumab plus radioembolization as salvage therapy for atezolizumab and bevacizumab refractory hepatocellular carcinoma resulting in complete pathologic response
pmc-11378113.creator: Claudia R Silver, Cynthia De la Garza-Ramos, John A Stauffer, Umair Majeed, Jianfeng Wang, Beau B Toskich
pmc-11378113.description: Unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma unresponsive to first-line immunotherapy has a poor prognosis with modest response to tyrosine kinase inhibitors in the second line. In these patients, the benefit of local therapy with immunotherapy rechallenge is unknown. Radioembolization is a guideline-supported locoregional therapy for HCC that has shown the potential for synergy in combination with immunotherapy.

pmc-11647691.title: Interleukin‐6 transcripts up‐regulation in lymph nodes from unicentric and multicentric Castleman disease
pmc-11647691.creator: Marco Lucioni, Gaia Morello, Caterina Cristinelli, Sara Fraticelli, Giuseppe Neri, Erica Travaglino, Marco Minetto, Francesca Antoci, Paolo Libretti, Marcello Gambacorta, Luca Arcaini, Claudio Tripodo, Marco Paulli
pmc-11647691.description: IntroductionCastleman disease (CD) represents a spectrum of heterogeneous lymphoproliferative disorders sharing peculiar histopathological features, clinically subdivided into unicentric CD (UCD) and multicentric CD (MCD) and presenting with variable inflammatory symptoms. Interleukin (IL)‐6 and other cytokines play a major role in mediating CD inflammatory manifestations.

pmc-11651465.title: Bibliometric analysis of global research on vitamins and cancer between 2003 and 2022
pmc-11651465.creator: Wen Wang, Xiangming Ye, Sisi Wang
pmc-11651465.description: Background:Vitamins are essential nutrients that play an indispensable role in maintaining the vital functions of the human body. A growing number of studies have shown a link between vitamins and cancer. However, there is no systematic review and bibliometric analysis in this field.

pmc-11745544.title: Twenty years of advances in prediction of nucleic acid-binding residues in protein sequences
pmc-11745544.creator: Sushmita Basu, Jing Yu, Daisuke Kihara, Lukasz Kurgan
pmc-11745544.description: Computational prediction of nucleic acid-binding residues in protein sequences is an active field of research, with over 80 methods that were released in the past 2 decades. We identify and discuss 87 sequence-based predictors that include dozens of recently published methods that are surveyed for the first time.

pmc-12440329.title: Changing Trends – Is Social Media Defining Modern-day Endodontics and Restorative Dentistry?

pmc-12880941.title: Quality of Life Changes Post-PCI With Contrast-induced Nephropathy
pmc-12880941.creator: Uzair N. Malik, Kashif Iltaf, Maria M. Ahmed Babiker, Prem Chand, Rakesh Kumar, Areesha Qureshi, Aajay Kumar, Muhammad H. Bari, Ali Karim, Sameet Kumar, Fnu Shweta, Fnu Rumela, Fnu Payal, Abida parveen
pmc-12880941.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the impact of contrast-induced nephropathy (CIN) on quality of life (QoL) in patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in Pakistan.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted involving 5325 patients who underwent PCI, divided into CIN (n = 1250) and non-CIN (n = 4075) groups. Demographics, clinical characteristics, and procedural details were recorded.

pmc-12951535.title: The Association of Periodontitis and Stroke History: Exploring the Role of Hypertension in a Cross‐Sectional NHANES Analysis
pmc-12951535.creator: Shi-Yin Jin, Qing Liu, Xiao-Qing Cao, Dian-Wei Wu, Yun-Fan Cai, Li-Na Niu, Wen Qin, Tao Ye, Carlos M Ardila
pmc-12951535.description: BackgroundPeriodontitis, a chronic inflammatory disease, and stroke, a leading cause of death and disability, share common risk factors and inflammatory pathways. However, the role of key mediators such as hypertension in this relationship remains to be fully elucidated.MethodsThis cross‐sectional analysis was conducted using data from the NHANES 2009–2014.

pmc-13239982.title: Climate Warming Will Reduce Boreal Forest Litterfall, but the Response Differs Among Plant Functional Types
pmc-13239982.creator: Wai Phyo Thu, Mark Jun M. Alcantara, Gbadamassi G. O. Dossa, Jill Thompson, Douglas Schaefer
pmc-13239982.description: Boreal forests are critical carbon sinks increasingly threatened by climate change. More than two‐thirds of this boreal carbon is stored in soil and litter, highlighting the crucial role of litterfall for carbon and nutrient cycling. Boreal forests have stands of different plant functional types (deciduous, evergreen, and mixed), and we lack information on their contributions to litterfall production.
